name: technical-triz
description: Classical engineering TRIZ: engineering and physical contradictions with the 40 Inventive Principles, Function Analysis, Trimming, the 76 Standard Solutions, Ideality, Resource Analysis, the System Operator, root-cause and patent analysis.

interface.longDescription: TRIZ (Theory of Inventive Problem Solving) methods for engineering problems. Formulate and resolve engineering and physical contradictions with the Altshuller Matrix, Matrix 2003 and the 40 Inventive Principles; model a system with Function Analysis or Substance-Field Analysis and apply the 76 Standard Solutions; trim components; find existing resources and derive new ones; trace root causes and root conflicts; extract contradictions from patents; and explore how a system evolves with the System Operator. For engineers, product developers and TRIZ practitioners. The Skills guide a structured analysis and suggest solution directions; they do not replace engineering judgment, testing or safety verification.
defaultPrompt: I have a technical contradiction: the housing must get stiffer without getting heavier.
Run a TRIZ function analysis of my system and identify its main function.
Walk me through the Innovation Situation Questionnaire for my problem.
